content.text: In regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible, leaving [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-20|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-5|Digital Product]] creators with limited options. This guide empowers you to deploy a fully operational digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-13|cloudflare]] Pages for free, enabling seamless crypto payments through NOWPayments. By leveraging COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can establish your commerce sovereignty and gain full control over your online sales without relying on restrictive platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms frequently restrict access based on geographic location or compliance issues, crippling creators' ability to monetize their digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure leverages decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, enabling you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC requirements. This approach ensures you maintain control over your business, circumventing the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors while positioning you for success in a global marketplace.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your store. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be necessary for managing backend logic. Your digital products—whether ebooks, courses, or software—should be prepared for upload. Additionally, set up a NOWPayments account to facilitate crypto transactions. With these prerequisites in place, you’re ready to start building your digital store without depending on third-party platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying Stack 01 using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for a straightforward setup, which can be completed in 4-6 hours. Configure your NOWPayments integration to enable instant crypto payment processing. Ensure product files are hosted on Google Drive for efficient delivery. This combination of tools establishes a reliable payment and delivery pipeline, ensuring your customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
Gain complete control over your digital store with no dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it's time to go live. Test your store by simulating transactions to verify that payments are processed correctly and that digital products are delivered seamlessly. Monitor the backend to confirm that orders are recorded properly. Once you're confident that everything operates smoothly, promote your store through social media or other channels. This proactive approach will help you attract your target audience and start generating revenue effectively.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, focus on scaling your operations. Explore Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, which allows for more products and enhanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. With the robust foundation established, consider expanding your product offerings or integrating additional payment options. Continuous optimization and testing will ensure your infrastructure remains resilient as you grow your business and reach new customers.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your infrastructure and start selling within hours, not weeks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script to manage your backend logic. Prepare your digital products for upload. Set up a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Deploy Stack 01 following the Sovereign Blueprint. Configure your payment integration and file delivery system. Test your store to ensure smooth functionality. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This setup enables you to sell digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for a quick deployment in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers with additional features, deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are effective hosting solutions for a digital product store. They allow you to set up a store without relying on restricted payment platforms.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02, also known as the Edge Commerce Stack, is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This ensures that your store is end-to-end tested before you take ownership.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose from a wide range of options for processing payments. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to diverse customer preferences.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies seamlessly.
